item.description:
• Experiments: upload screenshots straight into an App Store product page optimization experiment. Pick or create one, create or replace a treatment, then submit it or start it when the upload finishes.
  • Upload Product Page Header and Search Results artwork (iOS 27) to your version, a custom product page or an experiment, with editor presets for those sizes.
  • Collapse or expand every row at once from the View menu, the row menu, or by Option-clicking a row’s chevron.
  • Retrying a failed upload no longer renders your screenshots again, and the done screen has Back to upload another selection.
  • Row variants from the A/B testing beta are replaced by the new Experiment destination; existing variant rows open as ordinary rows.

• Upload log: if an App Store Connect upload fails, click Details, then Share Log…, and send the file to support so we can see what went wrong. You can also find it in Settings ▸ App Store Connect ▸ Upload Log. It never contains your API key or screenshots.
  • MCP agents can now move files to and from the app through the local server, and they get clearer guidance on replacing images.
